name: feature.docs.nodes
description: Product-docs feature node pack (ADR 0392) — two READ-ONLY nodes over the ctx.features.docs surface backing the docs.search / docs.get MCP tools. No authoring/mutation: docs are authored in the CMS and published through its editorial gate.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Docs Search
nodes.description: Searches published product documentation over ctx.features.docs → ranked hits (title, snippet, /docs URL, score). Read-only, tenant-scoped by the surface.

nodes.label: Docs Get
nodes.description: Fetches one published documentation page by slug over ctx.features.docs → title + full text + /docs URL. Read-only.
